svg.title: Naive RAG versus Production RAG architecture
svg.desc: Top: a simple five-box naive RAG pipeline labeled with no gates, no fallback, no evaluation. Bottom: a production RAG architecture with query rewriting, domain embedding, vector search, reranker, compressor, confidence gate with fallback branch, and a weekly evaluation loop feeding alerts back to retune the pipeline.
svg.text: ✕ No gates. No fallback. No evaluation.
